summary: Vipshop Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, reporting unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results via a press release. The filing discloses quarterly metrics: total net revenues of RMB24.7 billion, GMV of RMB50.6 billion, gross profit of RMB5.8 billion, and net income attributable to shareholders of RMB4.3 billion, which increased 189.1% year-over-year primarily due to a one-off investment gain from the listing of a commercial REIT. Non-GAAP net income was RMB392.2 million, impacted by a one-time withholding tax adjustment. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. No deal terms are stated; the filing is informational only.
